integrity: The finite-size identity is derived by a root-degree/protection-marked generating function. Exact rational calculations are independently compared with exhaustive parent arrays for n<=9; finite tests do not prove the all-size theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random recursive trees, integer sizes n>=3. No finite-order strict covariance sign or stochastic ordering is asserted. The asymptotic identity includes a proved O(n^-2) error. Implicit prior coverage by general marked-tree methods remains possible.
title: Root branching and two-protected vertices: an exact covariance and a negative limiting constant
